reviews.author: sree hari
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Amazing experience at La Brew Tabu Café! ☕✨
The food and coffee were excellent, and the atmosphere was very relaxing. All the staff are very friendly, helpful, and provide excellent service. Special thanks to Mr. Saeed for his great hospitality and professional service.

Highly recommended! Definitely a place I would love to visit again. ❤️

reviews.author: Nata Krasnoperova
reviews.text:
What an amazing experience! This place was such a wonderful surprise. Everything is truly top-level — the service is excellent, the food is easily 10/10, and the atmosphere is beautiful.

The moment you step inside, you feel like this place belongs somewhere on Jumeirah. Everything feels elegant, polished and very well thought out.

A special compliment to the staff — incredibly attentive and professional, but never intrusive, which I really appreciate.

I will definitely come back for the food and the whole experience. Thank you! Everything was beyond expectations and deserves the highest praise. 🤍

reviews.author: Heizel Cervantes
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed everything I ordered — the Spaghetti Bolognese, Iced Spanish Latte, and Margarita Pizza were all amazing. Everything tasted so good, definitely a solid 10/10! I have nothing but good things to say about the food.

The ambiance was also great. It was a nice and relaxing place where I could enjoy my meal and spend quality time. Special thanks to Ram for the warm welcome and for providing such friendly and attentive service.

I’ll definitely be coming back and I’m excited to try more dishes from their menu!

reviews.author: Mary grace Marticio
reviews.text:
Great Food, Refreshing Drinks, and Excellent Service!
I was out exploring when I came across La Brew Tabu. I decided to check out their menu first, and I ordered a club sandwich and a passion mojito.
I was honestly surprised by how delicious and worth it the club sandwich was! The serving was huge, and they also gave plenty of fries. Since it was really hot outside, the passion mojito was perfect for me. It was so refreshing!
I highly recommend this shop. They offer coffee, pasta, pizza, burgers, and more. Definitely worth a visit!
A special shoutout to the staff, Sanny and Dof. They were both friendly, accommodating, and provided great service. Thank you for making my visit even more enjoyable!
I will definitely come back again. Highly recommended! ❤️
